findings.summary: Stable Brain page document ID parser accepts malformed IDs with extra segments
findings.details: recordSnapshotInternal is intended to validate stable Brain page document IDs before resolving the revision fence. Its parser destructures documentId.split(':') into kind, brainKey, and pageKey and does not reject additional segments. A malformed value such as brainPage:<brainKey>:<pageKey>:forged is therefore treated as the valid page target instead of returning ValidationFailed. The focused tests cover valid forwarding and excess object properties, but not this false-green malformed documentId path, so malformed/ambiguous editor document IDs can be silently accepted.
